title: #321 Hurry in Life
prompt: Some people are always in a hurry to go to various places and get things done. Other people prefer to take their time and live a life at a slower pace. What is your opinion?

promptSegments.text: Some people are always in a hurry to go to various places and get things done.
Other people prefer to take their time and live a life at a slower pace.

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: A fast life helps people achieve their goals.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A fast life helps people achieve their goals.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A busy life helps people feel successful.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A busy life helps people feel successful.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that a slow pace of life is beneficial, countering the idea that people must hurry.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that a slow pace of life is beneficial, countering the idea that people must hurry.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay provides two reasons: better physical/mental health and stronger personal relationships.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay provides two reasons: better physical/mental health and stronger personal relationships.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that the pressure to achieve many things and the demands of modern life make a fast pace necessary.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that the pressure to achieve many things and the demands of modern life make a fast pace necessary.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay uses examples like students rushing projects and people using phones for work to support the idea of constant activity.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay uses examples like students rushing projects and people using phones for work to support the idea of constant activity.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that a slower pace of life is better than constantly rushing.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that a slower pace of life is better than constantly rushing.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay discusses how a slower pace improves mental health and strengthens social bonds.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay discusses how a slower pace improves mental health and strengthens social bonds.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss the benefits and drawbacks of living at different paces, ultimately arguing for a balanced approach.
keyArguments: A fast-paced lifestyle can increase productivity but may lead to stress and burnout.
A slower pace allows for relaxation and enjoyment but might result in missed opportunities.
